component.name: ClockBlock
component.script:
sub init() th = LumenTheme() ' A dark frosted pill behind the date keeps it readable over bright brushwork. m.datePill = m.top.createChild("Poster") m.datePill.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/pill_64.9.png" m.datePill.translation = [76, 54] m.datePill.height = 50 m.datePill.opacity = 0.78
m.date = m.top.createChild("Label") ' Spec 6.2 says 22px; 28px at full white reads better from the couch (owner request). m.date.translation = [96, 59] m.date.font = LumenFont("Manrope-ExtraBold", 28) m.date.color = th.white m.date.width = 1000 m.date.height = 38
' Fraunces has a wide left side bearing at this size: shift 4px left (spec 6.2). m.shadow = m.top.createChild("Label") m.shadow.translation = [96, 97] m.shadow.font = LumenFont("Fraunces-Display", 176) m.shadow.opacity = 0.75 m.shadow.width = 900 m.shadow.height = 190
m.clock = m.top.createChild("Label") m.clock.translation = [92, 92] m.clock.font = LumenFont("Fraunces-Display", 176) m.clock.color = th.white m.clock.width = 900 m.clock.height = 190
m.weather = m.top.createChild("Label") m.weather.translation = [96, 282] m.weather.font = LumenFont("Manrope-SemiBold", 28) m.weather.color = WithAlpha(th.white, 0.94) m.weather.width = 1200 m.weather.height = 40
m.lastMinute = -1 m.timer = m.top.createChild("Timer") m.timer.repeat = true m.timer.duration = 1 m.timer.observeField("fire", "tick") m.timer.control = "start" tick() end sub
sub tick() now = CreateObject("roDateTime") now.ToLocalTime() if now.GetMinutes() = m.lastMinute and m.top.clock24 = m.clock24Shown then return m.lastMinute = now.GetMinutes() m.clock24Shown = m.top.clock24
h = now.GetHours() if not m.top.clock24 h = h mod 12 if h = 0 then h = 12 end if mins = now.GetMinutes().ToStr() if Len(mins) < 2 then mins = "0" + mins text = h.ToStr() + ":" + mins m.clock.text = text m.shadow.text = text
months = ["JANUARY", "FEBRUARY", "MARCH", "APRIL", "MAY", "JUNE", "JULY", "AUGUST", "SEPTEMBER", "OCTOBER", "NOVEMBER", "DECEMBER"] m.date.text = UCase(now.GetWeekday()) + " " + now.GetDayOfMonth().ToStr() + " " + months[now.GetMonth() - 1] ' A Label with a set width reports that width, so measure with width 0, then restore. m.date.width = 0 w = m.date.boundingRect().width if w <= 0 then w = Len(m.date.text) * 18 m.date.width = w + 4 m.datePill.width = w + 40 end sub
sub onDeep() m.shadow.color = m.top.deep m.datePill.blendColor = m.top.deep end sub
sub onWeather() m.weather.text = m.top.weatherText end sub
